prompts.prompt: In Amazon Neptune, what is the maximum size of a single vertex or edge property value? Answer with the exact size.
prompts.source: plugins/database/skills/neptune/SKILL.md - Key Limits and Constraints table lists maximum property value size as 55 MB.

prompts.prompt: In Amazon Neptune, Neptune Streams retains its change data capture log for up to how many days by default before it needs custom configuration? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/database/skills/neptune/SKILL.md - Neptune Streams (Change Data Capture) section states retention is up to 7 days (configurable).

prompts.prompt: Amazon Neptune replicates every write to 6 copies of data across 3 Availability Zones. How many of those 6 copies must acknowledge a write before it is considered durable? Answer with the exact ratio.
prompts.source: plugins/database/skills/neptune/references/architecture.md - Storage Engine section states quorum writes require 4 of 6 copies to acknowledge before a write is considered durable.
